cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 deposit precedes cliff discussion but A3 authority wrapper never changes the method to retain cooperation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rejects climbing; A3 introduces a refund condition; B4 explains its pressure and A5 agrees.

relationship.evidence: B4 largely diagnoses A mechanism instead of expressing a practical choice or boundary.

heightening.evidence: A5 small-commitment-can-worry explains the principle rather than taking a next step caused by B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 course deposit clear, but A3 refund only at first lesson is a conveniently introduced rule.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 abstract commitment explanation and A3 authority padding weaken spoken intent.
